question: Which of the following dance form is related with Assam?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bihu is the famous dance form of Assam, a state located in northeastern India.
 
• It is an integral part of the Bihu festival, which is the most important festival in Assam and is celebrated to mark the agricultural cycle.
 
• Bihu is characterized by energetic movements, rhythmic footwork, and graceful hand gestures.
 
• The Bihu dance is performed by both men and women, usually in groups.
 
• It is accompanied by traditional Bihu music, which includes the use of instruments like the **dhol (a double-headed drum), pepa (a buffalo hornpipe), and taal (a cymbal).**
 
• The dancers wear colorful traditional attire, with women typically dressed in Mekhela Chador, a two-piece garment, and men wearing dhoti and kurta.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalbeliya **is a famous dance form of** Rajasthan, a state in northwestern India.**

 
 
• It is primarily associated with the** Kalbeliya community, a nomadic tribe **known for their snake-charming skills and their distinctive dance style.
 
• The Kalbeliya dance is an integral part of their cultural expression and has gained recognition and popularity worldwide. **The Kalbeliya dance** is characterized by its graceful and rhythmic movements, which imitate the fluid and sinuous movements of a snake. 
 
 
 
• **Kathak is one of the major classical dance forms of India, originating from the northern region of the country, particularly in the states of Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan.**
 
 
• It is a highly expressive dance form that combines rhythmic footwork, intricate hand gestures, facial expressions, and storytelling.
 
 
 
• **Bhangra is a lively and energetic dance form that originated in the Punjab region of India and Pakistan.**
 
 
• It is a traditional folk dance and music style that has become popular worldwide.
 
• Bhangra is associated with the harvest season and is often performed during festivals and celebrations.
